title: Egg Fried Rice
author: Claude
description: Day-old rice, eggs and peas tossed in a very hot pan. Best way to use leftover rice.

ingredients.note: cooked and cooled (ideally a day old)

steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large pan until very hot. Scramble the eggs softly and set aside.
Fry the garlic and the white parts of the scallions for 30 seconds, then add the peas.
Add the rice, breaking up clumps, and fry for 3–4 minutes until hot and a little crisp.
Return the eggs, add the soy sauce and sesame oil, toss, and finish with the scallion greens.
